about_the_game:
Manage your very own comic book store!

Step into the shoes of a comic book store owner and transform your humble store to a bookworm's haven!

Buy comic licenses, hire staff, and engage in various events such as book signings and collect rare version of comics and sell it at a premium! Use various tools to protect your store from troublemakers and keep your store clean! And explore the surrounding areas inspired by the Japanese backstreets!

Features :

  • Buy licenses to unlock comics, mangas, and manhwas of various genres!

  • Unlock and collect over 40+ comics, each with its own parodies & unique art!

  • Hire staff to help you with your store such as restocking, and security

  • Explore the surrounding areas with the backdrop of a Japanese backstreet

  • Decorate your store and make it more appealing to customers!

  • Upgrade your tools and unlock new rooms for your store!
